data.text:
I had a young guy (20 years old) reach out on IG, asking how he could effectively gain power and influence by the time he's 30.

Here's what I told him.

First, recognize that the "traditional path" is dead. You can't trust the advice of boomer (or Gen X) parents. Take their advice with caution: unless you're getting a degree from an elite institution, you'll likely end up saddled with debt and competing with third-world H1B applicants for a $60k/year job.

In most cases, the scorn and eyerolls from family FAR outweigh the alternative.

Instead, spend a week on YouTube learning a fundamental skill that will allow you to work remotely. Email marketing, content creation, building AI agents, etc. If you can't find a business willing to hire you, walk into 50 boomer-owned companies a day and pitch your service. The fact that you're young and saying words like 
"Meta ads" will cement your authority, despite any true experience. This is a language they don't speak, and they need help. 

Worst case scenario, find a simple trades job that pays decent; solar installation, HVAC, apprentice masonry/concrete, etc.

Your goal isn't to make this your full-time thing; it's to stack cash. 

If you live in an expensive metro area, you need to buy three things:

- A car you can comfortably sleep in
- A monthly membership at a nice gym with a co-working space and showers
- A power strip that can be plugged into a cigarette lighter in your car
- An air fryer
- A laptop (if you don't already have one)

Live as cheaply as possible. Spartan.

Again, your goal is to stack as much cash as humanly possible. $1,500/mo for a shitty apartment is $18,000 a year you're throwing away—just for a place to sleep.

Ideally, a rough breakdown of your income should look like:

- 50% should go into Bitcoin or other safe crypto investments (don't trust the S&P if you're young... a bubble is going to burst)

- 10% (~$700/mo) should go into an aggressive Roth IRA for long-term compounding growth and security.

- 20% should go into the education of a chosen skill or interest. E.g: An online business model (TikTok Shop, Amazon FBA, etc.)

- (if working remotely) 10% should go into automating your daily tasks to free up time. Hire a virtual assistant from the Philippines to do most of your work for you. Show up for the meetings when you have to. 

- 20% or less should go into basic living expenses: food, gym, gas, etc.

Your goal right now is to avoid, at all costs, "becoming a standard American adult." You don't need a furnished apartment, you don't need a car payment, you don't need debt, you don't even need a wife or girlfriend. 

You need escape velocity.

Your days should consist of:

- Necessary work (to stack cash)
- Working out and prayer (to stay on the path)
- Practicing your skill (this will eventually become your vehicle to escape)
- Meeting people, traveling, and connecting with others (explore, drive, network)

Whatever you choose to pursue: business, art, fitness, etc. You must post about it online. You must have a digital footprint. 

If you commit yourself to this lifestyle for 5 years, you'll come out the other side richer than 95% of your peers, with a learned skill and brand that you can monetize.

At this point, choose where you want to live, start looking for a relationship, and plan your next phase in life from a place of grounded certainty. 

You run your own business, make your own money, and can effectively leverage your cash to grow it further or influence the world in the direction you desire.

If this sounds outlandish—it is. This isn't your father's America. 

Creative thinking. Personal leverage. Intense and focused resource gathering. Omitting the standard timeline.

This is the new way.

TRAFFIC POLICE HEADQUARTERS, J&K, JAMMU/SRINAGAR 
TRAFFIC PLAN & ADVISORY FOR  18-09-2025:- 
NH-44 (NHW)
Jammu-Srinagar NHW (NH-44) has NOT been fully restored at Tharad, Udhampur. 

There was very slow movement observed on NH-44 due to intermittent rain, single lane traffic, undulating & uneven surface of the road at Tharad.  

Traffic managed on regulated manner at Tharad, Udhampur on NH-44 due to single lane about 250-300 Mtrs.

 Commuters are advised to follow lane discipline; overtaking, wrong lane driving will cause congestion.

Subject to fair weather and good road condition, tomorrow only one way traffic shall be permitted for LMVs from Jammu towards Srinagar on  NH-44.

These vehicles shall be allowed from Nagrota (Jammu) between 0700 hrs to 1000 hrs

No LMV shall be allowed from Srinagar towards Jammu on NH-44. 

LMVs going towards Distt. Doda, Kishtwar and Ramban from Jammu shall be allowed from Nagrota (Jammu) between 0700 hrs 1000 hrs.  However, LMVs/HMVs coming from Distt. Doda, Kishtwar and Ramban towards Jammu  will be permitted to move but these vehicle must cross the Nashri Tunnel before 1000 hrs. 

Mughal road is open for LMVs from Srinagar towards Jammu  and vice versa. 

HMVs/Load Carriers:- 
Subject to fair weather and better road conditions, HMVs shall be allowed from NAVYUG Tunnel (Qazigund side) towards Jammu after assessing the traffic situation and road condition on NH-44.  TCU Srinagar shall liaise with TCU Ramban before releasing the HMVs. 

SFs Convoy Movement:-
Security Forces are advised/requested not to ply against advisory /traffic plan in view of possible traffic congestion because of narrow carriage way between Tharad and Balinallah/Marog and Kishtwar Pathar on Jammu-Srinagar NHW. Tomorrow they may ply from Srinagar towards Jammu after confirming the status of NHW from TCU Ramban.

Kishtwar- Sinthan- Anantnag NH-244:- 
Subject to fair weather and good road condition, after getting green signal from NHIDCL, only LMVs shall be allowed from both sides viz from Anantnag towards Kishtwar and vice- versa on Kishtwar-Sinthan-Anantnag road. These vehicles shall be allowed from PP Parana towards Anantnag from 0800 hrs to 1600 hrs and from PP Daksum towards Kishtwar from 0900 hrs. to 1500 hrs. as per order issued by SDM Chhatroo vide No. SDM/C/2025-26/146-53 dated 16-05-2025 and SDM Kokernag vide No. SDM/KNG/665-71 dated 16-05-2025.     

SSG ROAD  
Subject to fair weather and good road condition, (after getting green signal from the BRO) traffic movement shall be allowed on regulated manner on Srinagar-Sonamarg-Gumari road. LMVs followed by HMVs shall be allowed from Minamarg towards Srinagar at 0500 hrs. to 1000 hrs. Similarly, LMVs followed by HMVs shall be allowed from Sonamarg towards Kargil at 1130 hrs to 1730 hrs . No vehicle shall be allowed after cut off timing. 
SFs Convoy, plying from Srinagar to Kargil and vice versa shall plan their movement in such a manner so that Civil Traffic (both UP and DOWN) don't get disturbed.

Mughal Road:- 
Subject to fair weather and good road condition, after getting green signal from Road maintenance agencies (GREF). LMVs Passenger/Private Cars shall be allowed from both sides viz Jammu towards Srinagar and vice versa via Poonch. These vehicles shall be allowed from Behramgala (Baffliaz) between 0600 hrs. to 1730 hrs  and from Herpora (shopian) between 0600 hrs and 1700 hrs as per advisory issued by District Magistrate Poonch vide  No. DMP/J/9291-9318 dated 31-08-2025. However, HMVs carrying fresh fruits six tyres only shall be allowed  from Shopian towards Poonch and No HMV shall be allowed after 1000 hrs. from Herpora Naka. Moreover, No HMV will be allowed from Jammu towards Mughal road. TCU Jammu and TCU Srinagar will inform all concerned about the traffic advisory and cut off timings.
